$comment: Accepted MISSING findings for tools/osm-drift-check.py, keyed by IDENTITY (slug|reason), never by count — a count ratchet stays green when one entry is resolved and another vanishes the same week, which is the event this check exists to catch. Adding a key here is a DECISION: write a note saying why. Removing a facility from the site is a separate, later act.

accepted.key: ha-grove-hospital-mpumalanga|object no longer returned by Overpass
accepted.name: Ha Grove Hospital
accepted.reason: object no longer returned by Overpass
accepted.note: Present on the FIRST run of this check (2026-08-19), so it predates the detector and cannot be attributed to a change we can date. Accepted so the guard ships GREEN and fires on NEW drift; NOT dismissed. Each still needs a by-hand verdict — an OSM object can disappear through vandalism, a merge into another object, or a retag, and only one of those means the facility closed. Burn-down list, not a clean bill.
